::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 18th [1889?]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

My dear [Lucy](people/person_2116.qmd)

If I can get a lift I shall be very glad to come to you, but it must rather depend on the ‘other house.’ Does [George](people/person_1611.qmd) know that we have the [Bishop Selwyn](people/person_1296.qmd), his [mother](people/person_1297.qmd), children and [new wife](people/person_1685.qmd) at the Vicarage for a month? [^1]

Your affectionate cousin
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The Rt. Rev. John Richardson Selwyn  (1844-1898), who became Bishop of Melanesia in 1877 and retired  to England finally in September 1891.  This letter may date however from his previous visit to England in June 1889-January 1890.  He had married his second wife Annie Catherine (Mort) Selwyn in 1885.
